_comment: Per-effect axis flags for Morrowind magic effects. Source of truth for which effects omit magnitude or duration in generated output. Readable by any script/language. Keys are magic_effect ids as they appear in tes3conv JSON (CamelCase, no spaces). Classification taken verbatim from UESP effect descriptions (en.uesp.net/wiki/Morrowind:Magic_Effects): the intro states that curing, summoning, teleportation, water breathing and water walking have NO MAGNITUDE; Paralyze is 'no magnitude, only duration'; Invisibility magnitude 'is not variable'; Lock/Open/Dispel have no duration (instant); Mark/Recall/Interventions are instantaneous (neither axis). Damage/Drain/Restore/Absorb effects explicitly act 'each second of the effect's duration' and therefore use BOTH axes - they are deliberately NOT listed here. Content was rephrased for compliance.
